supersedes.reason: The R11 post-build audit proved that acquisition time is a knowledge coordinate, not the concept business-validity lower bound.

knowledge_rule: knowledge_from is immutable source acquisition time; current evidence grants no visibility before acquisition
effective_rule: effective_from is the earliest report period that references the provider concept among evidence available at knowledge_from
revision_rule: emit a new knowledge revision only when newly acquired evidence moves the cumulative earliest referenced period backward
authority_boundary: The referenced-period lower bound supports fact-to-concept business-time validity only. It does not claim that the concept or current fact value was knowable before knowledge_from.
required_evidence: persist every staged source concept row in the sealed candidate
independently recompute deterministic same-knowledge selection and cumulative earliest-period revisions
bind each evidence row to parseable report-period and source-acquisition coordinates
close each knowledge interval at the next emitted revision
reject parallel concept states at one knowledge coordinate
